---
title: "In-Class Mapping"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Packages

```{r}
#install.packages("maps")
#install.packages("sf")
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(sf)
```

## U.S. State Boundaries

```{r}
us_states <- maps::map(
  database = "state",
  plot = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  rename(
    state_name = ID
  )
```

## Visible Map

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = us_states
) +
  geom_sf(
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Data Can Be Stored as Polygon Features",
    subtitle = "Each state is represented by a polygon geometry",
    caption = "Boundary data: maps R package"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

## Georgia County Boundaries

```{r}
georgia_counties <- maps::map(
  database = "county",
  regions = "georgia",
  plot = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  rename(
    county_id = ID
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    county_name = str_remove(
      county_id,
      "^georgia,"
    ),
    county_name = str_to_title(
      county_name
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = georgia_counties
) +
  geom_sf(
    fill = "#F3F4F6",
    color = "pink`",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Georgia County Boundaries",
    subtitle = "Each polygon can be joined to county-level health information",
    caption = "Boundary data: maps R package"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
